entities.name: Urgoros
entities.description: Specter from Vhelnish on Dominaria whose spirit was fused into his armor, serving Belzenlok.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: Demonlord who bestowed dementia magic on his followers.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Land whose skies Urgoros terrorized and whose volcano he lived in.

events.summary: Belzenlok bestowed dementia magic; Urgoros's body was siphoned into dementia space and his spirit fused into his armor.
events.quote: his body was siphoned away into dementia space

events.summary: Urgoros was the second defense against the Weatherlight's attack on the Stronghold.
events.quote: Urgoros was the second defense against the attack of the Skyship
